_note: C2 bootstrap endpoints — single source of truth for guard server domains. net.endpoint = role A AUTH servers ONLY (/api/v1/activate, /api/v1/guard/envelope); zxmqq.shop IS the auth server (ignore the .shop suffix), NOT a storefront; miyou.lol is the auth backup. AppConfig.guardServerList() reads ONLY net.endpoint keys (primary/backup1/backup2). cs.endpoint = role B funnel/CS landing (miyou.pro, owned by a different project); the funnel popup (RiskPromptController -> FunnelPrompt) reads it via NativeBridge.getEndpoint("funnel"). Keeping the funnel URL here (cert-only ciphertext) hides it from jadx/strings; it is NOT an auth server and is never iterated by guardServerList. Encrypted into native_core/src/bootstrap_cipher.inc by tools/gen_bootstrap_cipher.py with a CERT-ONLY key (derive_bootstrap_key, never folds the server seed) so endpoints decrypt BEFORE any server handshake (avoids the prod_server_lock deadlock). Shipped APK/SO carries only ciphertext; this plaintext is build input only. To add/reorder: edit here + re-run gen_bootstrap_cipher.py; no code change.
